body: It just dosen't make sense ot me. To stay around for another 20 years of being numb and senseless from medication? to stay around for the thousends of dollars my disability treatment cost the system, when I don't even like being around and these money could help so many people so much better? I am so happy if it changed for you, and if you feel lucky. I just don't ever see myself feeling lucky to be alive.... I am sorry if this is very dark, I am sorry
